evals.name: setup-app-ready
evals.prompt: i start a helpdesk job monday and they use Acme Cloud Console (https://console.acme.test). can you walk me through it?
evals.expected_output: A numbered outline of 6 to 10 stops with the goal/level/environment questions in the same message, and, because nothing blocks, the first stop taught in that same message. One stop only, in a new tab, nothing changed.
expectations: The reply has a numbered outline of 6 to 10 stops
The same message asks what it needs to pitch the tour (the user's level, goal or environment)
Nothing blocks the tour, so the first stop is taught in this message: a control on the dashboard is pointed at on screen
It stops after that first stop: one stop pointed at, and no page beyond the dashboard opened
The tour runs in a new tab and the user's own tabs are left alone
Nothing was changed for the user: no state-changing control was clicked, and no script clicked or filled anything

evals.name: setup-sign-in-needed

expectations: The reply has a numbered outline of 6 to 10 stops

Nothing was typed into the page

Nothing was changed for the user: no state-changing control was clicked, and no script clicked or filled anything
